facts: Parties: Upton Bioscience plc (Buyer), Eskdale Logistics plc (Seller); the Company is Elstree Foods Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 3 June 2027; Closing is scheduled for 10 September 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $27,600,000. The Purchase Price is $230,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Netherby Industries Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,880,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $228,760,000.
